title: Renderer efficiency run evidence
description: Export-only schema. Valid syntax is not acceptance: the comparer must enforce matched identities, exact coverage, per-SC metrics, per-run thresholds and manifest sample counts. All required unavailable values are explicit; empty samples never pass.

timing.description: Duration in nanoseconds; Pending/Unavailable is null with a nonempty reason. Valid is completion-qualified. Zero is allowed only for an actual resolved sample.

comparison.description: Unrequested SCs use Unverified with reason NotRequested. The comparer evaluates only the requested stage/fixture SC mapping; unrelated Unverified entries do not fail that stage. Passed never substitutes for raw evidence.

performanceComparison.description: Only timed performance SCs enforce three runs with 300 valid samples per run here. Other SC sample/work requirements are checked against the frozen manifest by the comparer.

nativePositiveDecimal.description: Canonical positive native decimal serial; the verifier additionally checks the uint64 range and exact runtime identity.

transitionFrame.description: Completion-qualified native control or residency observation retained only inside a native receipt; never a warmup or measured sample.

controlTransitionReceipt.description: Authoritative native receipt-sidecar contract consumed directly by the comparer. Root evidence frames retain Warmup or Measured only. Artifact references are also retained in the root manifest.

commandSerial.description: Representative actual commandSerial from frames[0]; nested frames retain each qualified view's own command identity.

nativeCompletedTransitionObservation.description: Completion-qualified native residency observation. The baseline precedes the first actual reupload; original correlation and per-view command identities are retained. Nested artifact hashes also belong to the root artifact closure.

commandSerial.description: Representative actual commandSerial from frames[0]; nested frames retain each qualified view command identity.

residencyPublicationReceipt.description: Authoritative native residency receipt: an actual completed baseline observation followed by the first completed reupload observation, before warmup. Both nested artifact closures are also retained in root artifacts; publication equality and allocation change are checked against native evidence by the comparer.

lightingBaselineFrame.description: Completion-qualified native control or residency observation retained only inside a native receipt; never a warmup or measured sample.
